qs.s: À sa grande ___, il a découvert que sa maison avait été vendue sans son accord.
qs.en: To his great astonishment, he discovered that his house had been sold without his consent.

qs.en: She watched the scene with astonishment, unable to utter a word.

qs.s: ___ stupéfaction générale a saisi la foule quand le verdict a été annoncé.
qs.en: General astonishment gripped the crowd when the verdict was announced.

qs.en: There was total astonishment in the room after this revelation.

qs.s: En marchant sur le chemin, elle a senti un ___ dans sa chaussure.
qs.en: Walking on the path, she felt a pebble in her shoe.

qs.s: Le jardinier a enlevé chaque ___ du sentier avant de planter les fleurs.
qs.en: The gardener removed every pebble from the path before planting the flowers.

qs.s: Pose ___ caillou sur la table, s'il te plaît.
qs.en: Put the pebble on the table, please.

qs.s: Ce matin, j'ai trouvé ___ caillou dans ma poche.
qs.en: This morning, I found a pebble in my pocket.

qs.en: On weekends, he likes to listen to reggae in his garden.

qs.s: Bob Marley est devenu célèbre grâce au ___ jamaïcain.
qs.en: Bob Marley became famous thanks to Jamaican reggae.

qs.s: Dans les années 1960, ___ reggae est né en Jamaïque.
qs.en: In the 1960s, reggae was born in Jamaica.

qs.en: On Saturday evenings, she likes to listen to reggae with her friends.
